title: Etale origin and constant-model transport of one finite quotient
statement: Let X be Noetherian, g:Y→X an immersion, d an adic coefficient datum on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], n≥0, and K a derived module over the actual nth finite coefficient ring on X [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Suppose K is bounded and every cohomology of its inverse image along g, restricted by pbcLevelConstantComparison, is relatively finite lisse. For any etale V→Y there is L in D(V_et,C/J^(n+1)), where C is the I-adic completion of A and J=IC. Its cohomology is finite locally constant and H^q(K)=0 implies H^q(L)=0 for each q. For every etale Z→V and every algebraic E in D(C/J^(n+1)), a supplied isomorphism L|Z≅constant(E) induces an isomorphism from constantAdicQuotientRealization(W.hom≫g,d,n)(E) to the actual inverse image of K on every proetale W over Z [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. The original restricted cohomology is relatively finite lisse on each proetale refinement W of V. There is no geometric point, no tower, no normalization, and no existence claim for a constant-model isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply exact inverse image and constant coefficient equivalences to K. Relative finite local models make its fixed-coefficient cohomology finite locally constant on Y. Since g is an immersion into a Noetherian scheme, Y is Noetherian and the one-stratum presentation is constructible. Transfer both separate cohomological bounds, and apply finite coefficient derived origin and fully faithful bounded-below comparison.

Reflect zero cohomology and finite local constancy through the exact faithful comparison. Restrict to V and transfer scalars along the inverse of constantAdicQuotientMap, whose inverse is completion evaluation. Restrict the descended comparison to a supplied constant E model on Z and then to W. Comparison-pullback coherence and the canonical finite-coefficient comparison identify the two sides with the specified realization and actual inverse image of K.

Pull the original covering sieve of finite constant module models along W→Y. Exact inverse image and its composition and coefficient-restriction comparisons identify these with the displayed pulled-back cohomology. Pullback stability of the topology gives the covering; the finite algebraic modules remain unchanged.

mathlib_searches.query: Bounded complex of finite locally constant proetale module sheaves descends to etale modules; constant sheaf realization detects derived scalar extension on a nonempty scheme
mathlib_searches.results: Eight condensed-module and ordinary sheaf hits per query. No etale-origin or normalized constant quotient diagram theorem in Mathlib.
No joint match. Exact functor localization, composition and identity isomorphisms for the second query; no coefficient-origin or consecutive quotient comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_quotient_etale_origin
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ,
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj K))))
    (V : Y.Etale) :
    Nonempty (LisseFiniteQuotientEtaleOrigin X Y g d n K V)
